decisions.reason: The DPA management tool fits the firm's agency and compliance focus, has its own page and positive customer feedback, and costs little to maintain, so in a growing industry with adequate slack it meets aspirations and gives no reason for problemistic search.
The management platform is featured on the home page in both years and is central to the agency-focused strategy, which signals that it meets or exceeds aspirations.
The configurable managed hosting plan sits close to the core business, keeps its own page, and directly supports revenue, so performance likely meets the aspiration level.

Extended PHP security support is only mentioned and depends on the PHP version lifecycle, so it may be repackaged later, but it addresses real customer risk at low cost and slack allows carrying it while results are uncertain.
